name: Deep Industries
desc: India's only integrated onshore+offshore oilfield-services platform; ~48% EBITDA margins, >₹3,000 Cr order book

name: Yasho Industries
desc: Specialty & fine chemicals; Q1 FY27 margin breakout to 23.2% EBITDA, CRISIL upgrade, 15-yr MNC lubricant contract

name: SML Mahindra
desc: Ex-SML Isuzu, now Mahindra-controlled CV maker absorbing M&M's Truck & Bus Division; transformation at a rich valuation

name: Ramkrishna Forgings
desc: Largest forging company in East India; cyclical CV-forging leader at inflection, diversifying into railways & castings

name: Tourism Finance Corporation
desc: India's only dedicated tourism lender diversifying; fortress balance sheet (CRAR ~57%), GNPA collapse to 0.37%

name: Vadilal Industries
desc: Branded ice-cream FMCG (the manufacturer, not Vadilal Enterprises); family dispute resolved, seasonal high-ROCE compounder

name: GHCL Textiles
desc: Yarn spinner demerged from GHCL Ltd, integrating into knitting/fabric; green-energy edge, ₹2,000 Cr FY30 target

name: Shadowfax Technologies
desc: Asset-light gig-based last-mile logistics platform; IPO'd Jan 2026, profitability inflection, extreme valuation & block overhang

name: 63 Moons Technologies
desc: Ex-FTIL special situation; below-book, cash-rich, NSEL overhang lifting (₹1,950 Cr OTS), 63SATS cybersecurity call option

name: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery
desc: Recently-IPO'd (Mar 2026) diamond-focused jeweller under P.N. Gadgil & Sons legacy; asset-light shop-in-shop model, funded store rollout, margins compressing on scale

name: Paushak
desc: India's largest phosgene-based specialty chemicals maker (Alembic Group); real hazmat moat & pharma/agro intermediates, but flat growth, compressed margins & premium valuation

name: Restaurant Brands Asia
desc: Burger King India (+Indonesia) master franchisee; loss-making QSR turnaround at inflection - record 12.6% India SSSG, EBITDA +266%, new promoter Inspira Global infused ₹1,050 Cr

name: Kabra Extrusiontechnik
desc: Kolsite Group dual-engine small-cap in transition: India's leading plastic-extrusion-machinery maker (cyclical, currently soft) pivoting to Geon (ex-Battrixx) Li-ion batteries for EV + energy storage. FY26 weak transition year (standalone loss, CRISIL downgrade, no dividend); Q1 FY27 turnaround (rev +44.8%, Geon +133%, EBITDA positive). Includes new Forensic Analysis section flagging 3 CFOs in 2 months, plant flood, strained balance sheet. Near-breakeven; value on SOTP, not P/E.

name: Navin Fluorine International
desc: A best-in-class, premium large-cap specialty-fluorochemicals leader — India's largest integrated fluorochemicals complex and Padmanabh Mafatlal group flagship (fluorine chemistry since 1967), across three verticals: High Performance Products (refrigerants/HFCs), Specialty Chemicals (agrochem/pharma organofluorines), and a fast-growing high-quality CDMO engine (a prime China+1 beneficiary). FY26 was spectacular: revenue +41% to ₹3,314 Cr, EBITDA +103% (margin to 32.6%), PAT +130% to ₹664 Cr. Deep fluorine moat, marquee contracts (Chemours commissioning), rich funded capex runway (HFC, Advanced Materials, DRDO), fortress balance sheet. BUT very demanding valuation (~68-80x P/E, ~8-10x book) — a peak multiple on partly-peak earnings, since FY26's margin leap is partly cyclical (HFC pricing) and base-driven — see Forensic (§14). Best valued on normalized through-cycle earnings. Educational, not advice.

name: Omnitech Engineering
desc: Recently-listed (Mar 2026) Rajkot precision-engineering exporter of safety-critical machined components for global energy, motion-control & industrial customers. China+1 beneficiary with a sticky certified-vendor moat (~97% repeat revenue, AS9100/API/IATF), ~₹3,000 Cr order book (~5-6x revenue) anchored by a >₹900 Cr Weatherford deal, and hyper-growth (rev 3x/PAT 4x in 2yr). But richly valued (~50-90x P/E), with a stretching working-capital cycle, US/energy/customer concentration, and a months-old listed history. A book-to-bill execution bet — see Forensic Analysis (§14): watch the cash. Educational, not advice.

name: Sudeep Pharma
desc: Recently-listed (Nov 2025) high-quality specialty-ingredients compounder — one of the world's leading makers of mineral-based pharmaceutical excipients & salts (Ca/Fe/Mg/Zn) for pharma, nutrition & food, US-FDA certified, 1,100+ customers, 100+ countries, with elite economics (~37% EBITDA, ROCE ~28-35%). FY26 rev ₹642 Cr (+28%), PAT ₹174 Cr (+26%). Two growth vectors: NSS Europe acquisition + a chemistry-adjacent pivot into battery-grade iron phosphate (LFP/LMFP) for EVs via Sudeep Advanced Materials (~₹300 Cr Dahej plant). But premium-valued (~45-60x P/E), with a ~213-day working-capital cycle (cash lags profit), customer concentration & an unproven, years-out battery bet — see Forensic (§14). A quality compounder + call option at a full price. Educational, not advice.

name: Morepen Laboratories
desc: A multi-engine pharma & healthcare turnaround at an earnings-inflection point. A 40-year, USFDA-clean (NIL 483 x4) API base now bolted to two higher-value engines: a long-duration CDMO platform anchored by a validated ₹825 Cr/$91M mandate (now commercializing — Q1 FY27 blockbuster: EBITDA +207%, PAT +394%), and a fast-growing 'Dr. Morepen' consumer-diagnostics devices platform (₹598 Cr, +21%, ~20M glucometer users, recurring strips, CGM runway, hive-off candidate), plus specialty optionality (Resmetirom/MASH). Strong low-debt balance sheet. But a 'show-me' turnaround: checkered long-term record, slow historical growth, low promoter holding (~35.7%), a base-flattered headline inflection, a repeatedly-delayed hive-off, and a material ₹117.94 Cr GST contingency — see Forensic (§14). Best valued sum-of-the-parts on forward earnings. Educational, not advice.

name: Palantir Technologies
desc: US mega-cap AI-software leader (Ontology + AIP; Gotham/Foundry/Apollo) posting an 'otherworldly' Q2 2026: revenue $1.94B (+93%, fastest ever), US-commercial +149%, Rule of 40 = 155%, GAAP net income >$1B, adj FCF $1.22B; FY26 guide raised to ~$8.15B (+82%). Fortress balance sheet (D/E 0.02), clean books, real cash. But the risk is PRICE, not the business: extreme valuation (~$398B mcap, ~42x fwd sales, trailing P/E ~107-219x) prices in years of flawless execution — see Forensic (§14): cash flow corroborates the story, valuation is the only red flag. Bull (Wedbush) $230 vs Burry bear $46. Educational, not advice.

name: ELANTAS Beck India
desc: A high-quality, debt-free, MNC-parented (ALTANA Group, Germany) niche specialty-chemicals leader (est. 1956) — India's dominant maker of wire enamels & insulating varnishes (~84% of sales, designed-in & safety-critical) plus engineering/construction resins (~16%). Elite economics (ROCE ~43.5%), a fortress net-cash balance sheet, global parent technology, and a structural electrification/EV/renewables/motor-transformer tailwind. After a soft FY26 (single-digit growth, margin contraction, an Ankleshwar regulatory scare, a ~30% de-rating), it posted a strong Q1 FY27 (rev ~+35%, PAT ~+80% YoY); Ankleshwar issue resolved, ₹56 Cr self-funded expansion underway. BUT a demanding valuation (~50x P/E vs ~13x industry, ~7.7x book) on a cyclical base whose rebound is base-flattered & unproven, with very low free float (~75% promoter, ~0% institutional → thin liquidity) — see Forensic (§14). Best valued on normalized through-cycle earnings gated on a proven growth re-acceleration. Educational, not advice.

name: Standard Engineering Technology
desc: A hyper-growth, recently-IPO'd (Jan 2025) precision-engineering leader (formerly Standard Glass Lining Technology, renamed Dec 2025) — one of India's top-3 makers of glass-lined, stainless-steel & nickel-alloy process equipment for pharma/chemical, with turnkey concept-to-commissioning solutions. A proven, cash-generative core (FY26 rev +26.7% to ₹793 Cr, PAT +21% to ₹83 Cr, net debt-free, ~₹1,000 Cr order book, 40-50% guided growth, record Q1 FY27 +41.5%) is now funding an aggressive, self-funded ~₹500 Cr pivot into the red-hot AI-datacenter engineering theme (GScale Energy, targeting ₹250 Cr FY27) plus Japan/tech (GL Hakko) — a compelling multi-engine re-rating story. BUT priced for success at ~67x P/E after a ~130% 6-month run, with real execution risk: a working-capital stretch (inventory ~doubled — growth consuming cash), margins (~17%) lagging revenue, modest ROE (~12.8%) on a large unproven capital deployment, equity dilution, an unproven AI-vertical, and only ~18 months of listed history — see Forensic (§14, two red flags). Best valued on forward P/E gated on order-book conversion + core-growth delivery + AI-vertical execution. Educational, not advice.
